# Erdos.p324 — Erdős problem 324

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/324
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/324.lean`, theorem `erdos_324.variants.quintic`, AMS 11).

Probably $f(x) = x^5$ has the property that the sums $f(a)+f(b)$ with
$a < b$ nonnegative integers are distinct.

## Statement
{(a, b) : ℕ × ℕ | a < b}.InjOn fun (a, b) => a ^ 5 + b ^ 5

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
